title: Custom Zip Geometric Pouch In Alligator

ld.name: Custom Zip Geometric Pouch In Alligator
ld.description: Pre-owned and now (re)loved, this Zip Geometric Pouch is a very special Coach custom design inspired by our commitment to rethinking and reducing our impact on the planet. Saved from the landfill, this gently-worn bag was lovingly repaired and transformed by our in-house craftspeople who added clever details to give it a second life. It’s completely one-of-a-kind, and comes with its own unique set of charms. Wear it, love it, pass it on. Reimagined by Rose Oliva with golden border rivets for a gleaming touch, this exotic style has been expertly cleaned, conditioned and restored. Our talented craftsperson Jose Reyna hand-decorated the front with polished studs and added a playful repurposed charm. Our Zip Geometric Pouch is part of The Coach Originals, a collection of archival-inspired bags that celebrates our legacy and authentic New York heritage. A polygon Coach bag from 1993 inspired this zip-top hexagon design. Crafted of luxurious genuine alligator leather, it has an organized interior and an exterior slip pocket for easy access to essentials.
